definitions.explanation: A sound that resonates or echoes.
The quality or impression of a sound or word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The sound of the bell could be heard from far away.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This word has a gentle ring to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sound of the piano is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The booming of the fireworks spread across the night sky.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: I like the ring of the word 'freedom.'

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外国語|がいこくご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ような→ようだ：26593_youda⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This name has a foreign-sounding ring to it.

notes:
{響|ひび}き is the noun form of the verb ⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (to resound), referring to sounds, echoes, and the impression they create.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き (the sound/ring of ~)
- {響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a ring/resonance)
- {響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (to sound good)

USAGE FOR WORDS:
{響|ひび}き can describe how a word or name "sounds" or the impression it gives. For example:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{響|ひび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (This name sounds nice)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{響|ひび}き (the ring of words)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {響|ひび}き vs. ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ is a general word for sound; {響|ひび}き specifically refers to resonating or echoing sounds, or the quality/impression of sound.

Register: Neutral to slightly literary. Often used when describing the aesthetic quality of sounds.
